learnings.text: Find why the accent never lands: accent family was 0/5 frames on all three Nov 3 renders; check where the accent is drawn before changing anything.

Run the language-per-beat study as a matrix, not a render order: assign each beat of one past title its language (orbit/hook, kinetic/emphasis, sweep/transition, rise/resolution) and note where the mapping fights the material.
Add a word-budget check to the gate: flag beat sheets whose on-screen text exceeds roughly 2-3 words per second before rendering.
Record critic per-check outcomes in memory, not just the overall FAIL, so the next ponder reads which checks passed/failed without reopening JSONs.
Keep probing the delivered MP4, never the header: resolution, fps, palette, and subtitles are measured from the artifact, not from what the render promised.
